title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Partnership
description: A partnership represents a formalized collaboration between various parties, each party playing a role in the partnership. The parties playing a role in the partnership represented by the Partner entity. The structure of a partnership is specified by a PartnershipSpecification which contain all the information for the setup of the partnership, including the list of identified roles and the agreement that should apply. (TM Forum TMF668 Partnership Management 4.0, Swagger definition Partnership; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Partnership:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Partnership'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Partnership/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Partnership:<tmfId>. The identifier of the partnership

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Partnership/properties/href'. The reference url for this partnership

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Partnership/properties/description'. An explanatory text regarding this partnership

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Partnership/properties/name'. An identifying name for the partnership.

partner.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Partnership/properties/partner'. The list of partners of the partnership, where a partner represents a party playing a given role. Hence a partner structure includes primarily a reference to the engaged party and a role name matching necessarily the name of one of the role specifications defined in the specification of the partnership.

specification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Partnership/properties/specification'. The specification of this partnership. In TMF this is a PartnershipSpecificationRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced PartnershipSpecification entity (urn:ngsi-ld:PartnershipSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
